notes.title: PathBlasters first update (1.0.1) is here!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, we're pleased to release a new update for PathBlasters!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44134611/a6089595f7e58d818e09d6b5d1b3cfe31751d7e1.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44134611/a6089595f7e58d818e09d6b5d1b3cfe31751d7e1.gif[/img][/url]

The biggest feature here is [b]Leaderboards[/b].

It comes in 3 modes: infinite, time attack and score attack. There is one leaderboard per level, and infinite mode has different ones for each difficulty mode. And you can filter them in Friends, Global and Top!

Other impactful improvements are:

[list]
[*] [b]A new hard difficulty in infinite mode![/b]
[*] Earn pixons when obtaining new medals.
[*] Earn also more and more pixons as you go far in infinite mode!
[*] We added many sounds that were missing in the released version.
[*] Displaying a "3,2,1" timer at the end of score attack timer.
[*] Controls menu is now available from multiplayer ingame menus (not in solo as they are always available in the bottom left corner of the screen)
[/list]

We also added credits in the game menu!

Here is an overview of the bug fixes:

[list]
[*] Fixed volume control (now linear while it was decreasing too fast along the slider).
[*] Many bug fixes in the menu flows.
[*] Fixed the characters sliding while summoning cristals
[*] Localization fixes.
[*] Fixed guardian's color which became black under certain conditions.
[*] Score attack: now waiting for all the points to be taken into account before playing the end screen.
[/list]
